original_test_intent: Measure the selected GPU's clpeak floating-point and related OpenCL characteristics and compare them with an approved GPU specification under controlled conditions.
original_method: Record GPU BDF/model, firmware/driver, OpenCL ICD/platform/device and clocks/power/temperature; install approved compatible clpeak; confirm target and supported precisions; capture baseline health; run complete clpeak for approved repetitions and interpret the one-minute step; monitor health; retain all FP/integer/memory/latency output; restore profile and compare to versioned metric-specific tolerances.
manual_activity: GPU owner selects device/runtime/clpeak version, precision/metric thresholds and one-minute/repeat profile; agent may install/validate and run after approval.
required_inputs: Approved OpenCL ICD/runtime/platform/device and clpeak package/version/hash
Required FP16/FP32/FP64/integer/memory/latency metrics and support expectations
Versioned GPU specification, per-metric tolerances and comparable conditions
Interpretation of one-minute step, repetitions/aggregation, thermal/power abort and cleanup
safety_requirements: Confirm target device and isolate workload before run
Use approved package sources and authenticated access
Stop on wrong device, OpenCL error, reset, thermal/power limit or instability
No automatic retry; restore approved power/clock profile and retain failures
agent_execution_scope: Validate GPU/OpenCL identity, package/profile and baseline health
Run approved clpeak repetitions and preserve full output/telemetry
Do not select device/spec/tolerance, upgrade drivers independently, rerun or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve GPU/OpenCL/clpeak combination and precision scope
Define wait/repeat profile and metric thresholds

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unsafe/incomplete: unpinned apt install, insecure SSH, first-device assumption and `head` truncation can hide metrics or errors.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate the approved OpenCL platform/device, run the pinned clpeak build against that target with complete stdout/stderr, and capture synchronized GPU telemetry for each approved repetition and one-minute observation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Driver/OpenCL/clpeak prerequisites, full clpeak run, one-minute wait and GPU-spec comparison are retained pending exact profile interpretation.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute clpeak on one explicitly mapped OpenCL GPU with complete metric output and steady-state telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds identity, runtime/version pinning, precision scope, repeats, tolerances and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Truncated output cannot establish all FP/integer/memory/latency metrics or reveal runtime errors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: clpeak is a microbenchmark; clocks, throttling, compiler/runtime and unsupported FP64 can explain divergence from marketing peak.

project_override_considerations: Decide whether 'match GPU spec' refers to theoretical peak or an approved clpeak baseline and which clpeak metrics are mandatory. Unsupported FP64 must not be treated as failure unless the GPU specification requires it.
expected_evidence: Complete FP/integer/memory/cache/latency output for every repetition
GPU utilization/clock/power/temperature/error telemetry and system logs
One-minute observation interpretation, per-metric threshold comparison, restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently asks for clpeak on an OpenCL-capable GPU and comparison to specification. Missing target, profile and tolerances are inputs, not contradictory coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Compatible runtime/package, device mapping and specification can be supplied; static test intent is clear.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Performance row38 Wistron-Performance GPU-00054-V003: approve exact GPU BDF/OpenCL platform/device, driver/ICD/runtime and clpeak version/hash; define required FP/integer/memory/latency metrics, precision-support expectations, whether the one-minute step is duration or observation, repetitions/aggregation and versioned GPU-spec tolerances, plus clock/power/thermal abort and cleanup policy.

review_improvement: Turns an unpinned first-device run into a device-attributable OpenCL benchmark with complete metric and telemetry evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: clpeak reports multiple kernels whose attainable values depend on vector width, compiler/runtime, precision support and active clocks. Theoretical peak is not necessarily the correct empirical threshold, and a wrong OpenCL device can still return plausible output. Exact platform/device identity, full output and thermal/clock context are therefore essential.
